messages:
marco: FYI kicking off the SFO GPU region prep. This thread is the single source for oncall orientation, paging configs, ownership, and training notes. Docs: https://intranet.redwood/sfo-gpu-playbook :rocket:

marco: TL;DR — we have 8 H100 nodes in sfo1, nodepool 'sfo-gpu-prod'. Key handoff items: paging policy, test pages, network egress rules, runbook link, cost tags.

tina: thanks. can we get the exact PD escalation chain here? want to make sure rotations know who to page first.

priya: escalation order we agreed: primary oncall (sre-oncall), if no ack 5m -> priya (SRE lead), 10m -> eng-infra pager (ryan), 20m -> exec notify (ops@redwood). PD policy name: "SFO GPU - Priority".

ryan: PD service key is in vault path: secret/platform/pagerduty/sfo-gpu (only eng-infra + priya have write). I can open a read-only link for oncall.

ashley: from ops: network constraints — sfo1 restricts 172.16.0.0/16 egress to third-party repos, need proxy for container pulls. added note in doc.

marco: validation checklist (short):
```
- verify node count: kubectl get nodes -l pool=sfo-gpu-prod
- run perf smoke: curl -sS https://sfo-gpu.example/health | jq .latency_ms
- test kv cache warm: run bench script in infra/tools
- PD test page: deploy-bot trigger test
```

kevin: adding PD test snippet you can run from your laptop:```bash
curl -X POST https://events.pagerduty.com/v2/enqueue \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"routing_key":"REDACTED","payload":{"summary":"SFO GPU test page","source":"playbook","severity":"info"}}'
``` replace REDACTED with the read-only key.

deploy-bot: triggered test page -> incident created: PD-INC-12345 (simulate). :white_check_mark:

tina: good — please make sure the oncall docs include the PD ack windows and the troubleshoot steps for common alerts: GPU OOM, kernel panic, nvlink flaps, high packet drops.

marco: noted. snippet for alert thresholds we set in prometheus: `gpu_memory_utilization > 0.9 for 2m`, `node_cpu_system > 0.85 for 5m`, `net_device_drops > 100`

priya: ownership matrix: SRE owns paging, initial triage, escalation. Eng-infra owns provisioning, kernel/driver patches, capacity scaling. Platform team (marco) owns model-serving fallbacks and routing policies.

ryan: capacity & cost notes — H100s are expensive. auto-scale strategy: keep 2 reserved, 6 preemptible-style for burst. tag all nodes with `cost-center: research` or `product: inference` depending on usage. Billing alerts tied to monthly spend > $X.

ashley: network runbook snippet for firewall: allow egress to registries on 443, allow NTP & internal mgmt 10.0.0.0/8, block inbound from public unless through LB.

marco: training: quick 30m orientation scheduled Thu 10am PT — we'll cover PD flows, playbook walkthrough, and a test page drill. RSVP: @tina @priya @ryan @kevin @ashley

kevin: I'll prepare a short lab with a simulated OOM alert and a PD drill. plan to use sandbox project so no real infra impacted.

tina: one more ops detail — please add the oncall rotation steps: how to escalate to platform after hours and a clear list of who has sudo for node reprovisions. put the sudo list in vault only.

marco: agreed. action items: 1) ryan share read-only PD key link 2) kevin hand over lab for Thu 3) ashley update firewall section 4) priya finalize escalation wording 5) tina add triage checklist. We'll close this thread after orientation and a successful PD test. :white_check_mark:

priya: acked. I'll run a quick tabletop with the oncall team Friday.

tina: thanks everyone. leaving a quick snippet for common commands in the playbook:```bash
# check GPU node readiness
kubectl get nodes -l pool=sfo-gpu-prod -o wide
# describe any pod stuck in CrashLoop
kubectl describe pod <pod> -n inference
# pull logs
kubectl logs -f <pod> -n inference
```

marco: closing loop — orientation invite sent. please post any follow-ups in this thread. :handshake:
